QuestInfo.name: Eliminating Battle Hounds
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #b#p3001001##k and find out what you can help with.
QuestInfo.1: Specters launched an ambush with #r#o2400106##k monsters. Eliminate the #r#o2400106##k monsters that broke through the front lines and save the Heliseum Reclamation HQ.\n\nThere are a ton of #r#o2400106##k enemies at the #b#m401010000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You bought some time by eliminating the #r#o2400106##k monsters. Go find out what else you can do for the HQ.

0.0: Okay, ready. We think that the enemy #r#o2400106##k unit played a big part in Specters' attack on the HQ. At least, that's what #b#p3001000##k says.
0.1: Stupid Battle Hounds! They sniffed us out and attacked us where it hurts! It's those #r#o2400107##k things that are breading the #r#o2400106##k!
0.2: If you can take out maybe #b100#k of the #r#o2400106##k forces, they won't be able to sniff us out like that again.
0.3: I wish I could see their beady little eyes while you're out there clubbing their hounds! \r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: There's the spirit. I'd love to get out there and kick some of those critters around myself, but #p3001000#'s got me heading up the troops. Never get yourself promoted, kid.

no.0: Oh, sorry your majesty. Maybe I can drum up something more worthy of your time.

yes.0: Now only half of them will come back missing a leg! Hahaha!
yes.1: The only thing now is to clear out some more of the stragglers and send out the boys to secure a good route. In the meantime, #b#p3001000##k has some work for you.

mob.0: You still haven't knocked off #r#o2400106##k monsters. Stop loitering around here and get going!
